{{Top|leg}}
'''Lord Council''' was a title held by the leader of the [[Kadrillian/Legends|Kadrillian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], during the [[Invasion of Kadril|invasion]] of the Kadrillian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], a Kadrillian named [[Lon Prador]] held the title.<ref name="PoK">"[[Planet of Kadril]]"</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The title of Lord Council was first used in ''[[Planet of Kadril]]'', a comic strip published in [[1980]] by the [[Los Angeles Times Syndicate]] and written by [[Archie Goodwin]] under the name [[Russ Helm]].
